description: Enhanced creative workspace: brief status, production progress, deliverable gallery, revision timeline, smart notifications, project history. Read-only adapter layer — no writes to shared tables.

routesToMount.note: Import the default export and add: router.use(creativeWorkspaceRouter); — no path prefix needed, routes self-register under /public/customer/creative-workspace/*

pagesToRegister.note: Project detail with tabs (Brief / Progress / Files / Reviews / History)

sharedTypesRequested.name: WorkspaceSession
sharedTypesRequested.note: Imported read-only — Team 2 does not modify this type

integrationOrder: 1. Team 24 mounts the router from routes/customer-creative-workspace/index.ts in routes/index.ts
2. Team 24 registers the 5 pages above in the customer-portal App.tsx Wouter routes
3. No migration execution needed (no new tables)
securityNotes: All routes validate the workspace token via resolveWorkspaceSession() before any data access
All project queries delegate IDOR protection to verifyProjectOwnership() (uses existing service)
No storagePath fields in any response DTO
No imageUrl (from creative_ai_assets) in any response — sign endpoint provided instead
No provider / model / tokenUsage / cost / prompt data in any response
No reviewTokenHash or reviewTokenPlain exposed — only reviewUrl built from plaintext for the session owner
customerNotificationReadsTable inserts are scoped to session.emailHash
knownRisks: creativeAiClientReviewsTable.reviewTokenPlain is only set for customer-submitted projects; direct projects may return reviewUrl: null
canonicalEventService.getEventsForProject — if the eventId is not a string UUID in older rows, the history endpoint returns an empty array gracefully
notification synthesis is stateless — synthesized IDs (e.g. synth-review-XXX) are stable per project state but regenerated on each request
